## Squad

This project uses Squad through the Squad Claude Code plugin. Install it once (`claude plugin marketplace add github/squad`, then `claude plugin install squad@squad`) and run `claude`: `.claude/settings.json` starts the `squad:squad` coordinator to work with the team defined in `.squad/team.md`. Shared state is served by the plugin's `squad_state` MCP server.
